CIA-UAP-017, Placement on High Alert Due to Perceived Aggressive Foreign Posturing
CIA-UAP-017、外国の攻撃的な態度と思われるため、厳戒態勢が敷かれています
CIA
6/12/26
July, 2008
Harare, Zimbabwe
PDF
A never before released July 2008 report on a UFO sighting at the Harare International Airport. Individuals debated if the sighting was an advanced reconnaissance device of a foreign government or of extraterrestrial origins.
2008 年 7 月にハラレ国際空港での UFO 目撃に関するこれまでに発表されたことのない報告書。この目撃情報が外国政府の高度な偵察装置によるものなのか、それとも地球外起源のものなのか、人々は議論した。

documents.summaryText:
2008年7月3日付の中央情報局情報報告（最終評価前）。報告はジンバブエ発で、2008年7月2日午後にハラレ国際空港上空の高高度で未確認物体が観測されたと記述している。物体はレーダーおよび光学手段で観測された可能性があり、物体から「ビーム」が出ているのが確認された。目撃者の説明では、物体は中央が空洞の円盤状で、下面に回転する灯があり、その灯が色を変えた後に急速に上昇して視界外へ消えた。関係者の中には外国政府の高性能偵察機器と見る者や地球外起源のUFOと見る者がいた。発生を受けてジンバブエは高警戒態勢に置かれたとされる。
CIA information report dated 3 July 2008 (not finally evaluated). Reporting from Zimbabwe states that on the afternoon of 2 July 2008 an unidentified object was observed at high altitude over Harare International Airport, possibly by both radar and optical means. Observers reported beams emanating from the object. It was described as disc-like with a hollow center and a series of rotating lights on the underside; the lights changed color and the object then rapidly ascended out of visual range. Some individuals characterized it as an advanced foreign reconnaissance device, others as an unidentified flying object (extraterrestrial). The incident prompted Zimbabwe to be placed on high alert.

This document is an FBI FD-1057, a form the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) uses to record investigative activity. This FD-1057 contains a first-hand narrative description of unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) reported near Colorado Springs, Colorado. The interviewee provided this statement to FBI special agents to aid in producing a digital artistic interpretation of the incident.
この文書は、連邦捜査局 (FBI) が捜査活動を記録するために使用する形式である FBI FD-1057 です。この FD-1057 には、コロラド州コロラドスプリングス近郊で報告された未確認異常現象 (UAP) についての直接の物語的記述が含まれています。インタビュー対象者は、事件のデジタル芸術的解釈の作成を支援するために、この声明を FBI 特別捜査官に提供しました。

documents.summaryText:
FBIの鑑識スケッチ面接記録（2024年7月11日付）。被面接者（氏名は秘匿）は26 Federal Plaza（ニューヨーク）で特別捜査官およびOPU鑑識アーティストに面接された。被面接者は元米陸軍情報将校で、部隊の他4名とともにオフィスを出た際にチェイエンヌ山上空で未確認飛行現象（UAP）を目撃した。目撃時刻は午前11:25頃、天候は雲なし・低湿度・気温約50°Fの晴天。物体は「ジャガイモ型」で輪郭が明瞭、クリーミー〜白色のオパール状でやや半透明、わずかにきらめきがあった。表面は非対称・重なりのない不規則な魚の鱗状またはパネル状の構造で構成され、物体本体は静止していたが各パネルが異なる起点から同時にゆっくり波打つように動いた。約2分後に物体は消え（被面接者は“cloaked”と表現）、消失時に影は見られなかった。初期スケッチ草案が添付されており、鑑識アーティストが追加草案をSA経由で被面接者に送る予定と記載。
FBI forensic sketch interview record (dated July 11, 2024). The interviewee (name redacted) was interviewed at 26 Federal Plaza, New York, by a Special Agent and an OPU forensic artist. The interviewee, a former U.S. Army intelligence officer, along with four unit members, observed an Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon (UAP) over Cheyenne Mountain as they exited their office. Observation time about 11:25 AM; weather was clear (“blue bird” sky), low humidity, approximately 50°F. The object was described as potato-shaped with distinct edges, creamy/whitish opalescent in color, somewhat translucent with a slight shimmer. Its surface consisted of non-symmetrical, non-overlapping, irregular fish-scale– or panel-like elements; the overall object was perfectly still while individual panels shifted in slow waves starting from different points of origin simultaneously. After about two minutes the object vanished—the interviewee stated it “cloaked” in the time it took to turn their head—and no shadow was observed. An initial sketch draft is attached; the forensic artist will relay additional drafts through the SA to complete the final sketch.

初公開
documents.summaryText:
2026年2月、（氏名等は秘匿）に対してFBI捜査官がMicrosoft Teamsで面接を実施。帰宅時、裏庭の樹木近くに直径約1メートルの赤い球体を目撃。球体中心にバスケットボール大の白いプラズマ状の「太陽」のようなものが見えた。さらに同一の第二の赤い球体が現れ、二つは左上へ移動後、木の上方を西へ無音・滑らかに編隊のように移動し、視界から離れる際に一つに合体したか非常に接近して一つに見えた。当時の映像を撮影し文書に添付。数週間後、被面接者は西から東へ高高度を移動する複数の白い小球（腕を伸ばして持った十セント硬貨大に相当）を観察したと述べた。
In February 2026, FBI agents interviewed (name redacted) via Microsoft Teams. While returning home the witness observed a red orb approximately 1 meter in diameter in their backyard, with a basketball-sized white plasma-like 'sun' at its center. A second identical red orb appeared above the first; the two moved up and to the left, then west above the tree line, moving silently and smoothly in tandem (described as flying in formation or tethered) and, as they left view, merged into one or were so close they appeared as one. The witness and another person recorded video of the event, which is attached to the interview. Several weeks later the witness reported seeing multiple white orbs at much higher altitude traveling west to east, described as about the size of a dime at arm's length.

この文書は FBI FD-302 であり、連邦捜査局がインタビューを記録するために使用する形式です。この FD-302 は、未確認の異常現象が関与している可能性がある事件の直接の説明に関する米国人へのインタビューを記録しています。ファイル FBI-UAP-D009 および FBI-UAP-D010 に記述され、ビデオ映像 FBI-UAP-PR004 に描かれている主題は、米国北東部の同じ一般地域から発信された報告に対応しています。
初公開
documents.summaryText:
FBIの捜査官が匿名（氏名は黒塗り）を面談した報告。報告によると、被面談者は午後9時15分頃に帰宅直後、フロントガラス越しに黄色でバスケットボール大の光の球を認め、車を降りるとさらにビーチボール大の別の光の球を目撃した。これらは家裏手の隣地との間の樹木列の手前にあり、目に負担や不快感はなかった。捜査官の注記では、観測場所から物体は約30ヤード離れ、地上20–30フィートの高さにあったと推定される。別の同居者も外に出て確認し、両者は物体が左へ横移動して約36ヤード先の木の後ろを同じ高さで通過し、隣家裏を経てさらに約75（単位不明）先の木の向こうへ進んだのを観察した。数週間後には別に西から東へ家屋上空を移動する複数の白いオーブを、先の赤いオーブより高高度で見たと述べている。また1987年には送電線付近で夜間に自回する赤い光を目撃し、テレビ番組『Knight Rider』の前部のようだと表現した。物体がホバリングして発電所近くに着地するのを見たとも述べており、それ以来UAP（OAP）の話題に興味を持っている。捜査官が被面談者の許可を得て撮影した写真が添付されている。文書はFBIの所有物であり推奨や結論は含まれない旨が記載されている。
FBI interview report of a redacted subject. The subject reported arriving home at about 9:15 PM and, through the windshield, seeing a yellow, basketball-sized ball of light; upon exiting the vehicle they saw a second, larger, beach-ball-sized light. The objects were located in front of a row of trees between the subject's property and a neighbor's; the subject experienced no eye strain or health issues after the sighting. An agent note estimated the objects were about 30 yards away and 20–30 feet above ground. A second person came outside and both observed the objects move laterally left, passing behind a tree ~36 yards away at the same height, continuing behind a neighbor's house and beyond a tree about 75 (unit unclear) away. A few weeks later the subject reported seeing several white orbs moving west-to-east above the house at much higher altitude than the earlier red orbs. The subject also reported a 1987 sighting near power lines of a red light circling itself—likened to the front of the TV show Knight Rider—and said they saw an object hover and then land near a power station. The subject has remained interested in OAP/UAP topics. Photographs taken by agents with the subject's permission were attached. The document notes it contains no FBI recommendations or conclusions and is FBI property.

This collection of documents contains correspondence between the Director of the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI), J. Edgar Hoover, and Rev. Charles Barnes concerning Barnes’ account of an incident potentially involving unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP). Rev. Barnes described observing four beams of light “converging in the Cascade Mountains,” at an altitude of approximately 10,000 feet, with a “great explosion” visible at the convergence point of those beams for at least ten minutes. Director Hoover replied to Rev. Barnes thanking him for his letter and informing him that he had forwarded it to the Atomic Energy Commission (AEC). Director Hoover conveyed to the AEC that Rev. Barnes believed that the event may relate to a military or scientific experiment within the commission’s purview.

FBI-UAP-PR003, “Orbs Over the Pond,” 2024
FBI-UAP-PR003、「池の上のオーブ」、2024
FBI
6/12/26
October, 2024
Northeastern United States
VID
In October 2024, at approximately 1851 local time in the northeastern United States, an eyewitness observed a light source below the horizon, hovering above a pond at an estimated distance of 2,700 feet. The luminous object resembled a “plasma-like sphere” intermittently changing shape and luminosity. At times, the primary light source appeared to separate into smaller luminous points. A luminous point below the primary source hovered just above the water and did not appear consistent with a surface reflection. The object remained generally stationary for approximately 45 minutes before disappearing. The eyewitness did not hear any sound from the objects. This video was captured by a private citizen on an iPhone and subsequently analyzed and authenticated by the U.S. Government. To protect the individual’s privacy, the footage has been cropped. Apart from this privacy-protective measure, no edits, enhancements, or alterations have been made to the visual content. The description above is derived from statements provided to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) by an eyewitness to the event. The FBI assesses the individual who reported this event as highly credible. The subject matter described in files FBI-UAP-D004 through FBI-UAP-D008 and depicted in the video footage FBI-UAP-PR001 through FBI-UAP-PR003 corresponds to reports originating from the same general area in the northeastern United States.

FBI-UAP-PR004, “Northeastern Orb Sighting,” 2025
FBI-UAP-PR004、「北東のオーブ目撃」、2025 年
FBI
6/12/26
July, 2025
Northeastern United States
VID
In July 2025, at approximately 2100 local time in the northeastern United States, an eyewitness observed an intense bright light in their backyard as they parked their car upon returning home from work. The light was hovering approximately 25 feet off the ground, below a tree line near the center of their backyard, at an estimated distance of 90 feet. The eyewitness exited their vehicle briefly before retrieving their phone to record the event. The spouse of the eyewitness came outside to assess the situation. The spouse also witnessed the light, describing it as a “brilliant red sphere” about one meter in diameter. The center of the red sphere appeared to be a white plasma “sun” about the size of a basketball. The orb slowly rose and moved to the left, and both eyewitnesses observed a second, identical orb, hovering above the other orb. The eyewitness then began recording the event using an iPhone 14 Pro Max, capturing the footage depicted in this video. As the eyewitness began recording, the orbs moved westward together above a nearby tree line. The witnesses described the orbs’ motion as silent and smooth, and as moving in tandem as though they were flying in formation or tethered together. As the orbs moved out of sight, both eyewitnesses saw them appear to merge. The eyewitnesses estimated that the orbs moved from their initial position before disappearing from view at an estimated distance of 75 yards. This observation occurred within 25 miles of the “Triangle Orbs,” “Red Orb Rotation,” and “Orbs Over the Pond,” sightings at a location well known to them, which is sparsely populated. The description above is derived from statements provided to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) by eyewitnesses to the event. The FBI assesses the individuals who reported this event as credible. The subject matter described in files FBI-UAP-D009 through FBI-UAP-D010 and depicted in the video footage FBI-UAP-PR004 corresponds to reports originating from the same general area in the northeastern United States.
2025年7月、米国北東部の現地時間約21時、目撃者は仕事から帰宅して車を駐車した際、裏庭で強烈な明るい光を目撃した。光は地面から約25フィート、裏庭の中心近くの樹木限界の下、推定距離90フィートのところで浮かんでいた。目撃者は車から少し降りてから、携帯電話を取り出して出来事を記録しました。目撃者の配偶者が状況を確認するために外に出た。配偶者もその光を目撃し、それを直径約1メートルの「鮮やかな赤い球体」だったと説明した。赤い球体の中心は、バスケットボールほどの大きさの白いプラズマ「太陽」のように見えました。球体はゆっくりと上昇して左に移動し、両方の目撃者は、2 番目の同一の球体がもう一方の球体の上に浮かんでいるのを観察しました。その後、目撃者はiPhone 14 Pro Maxを使用してイベントの録画を開始し、このビデオに描かれている映像をキャプチャしました。目撃者が記録を開始すると、球体は近くの森林限界の上を西に向かって一斉に移動した。目撃者らは、球体の動きは静かで滑らかで、まるで編隊を組んで飛んでいるか、つながれているかのように連動して動いていたと述べた。球体が見えなくなると、両方の目撃者はそれらが合体しているように見えるのを目撃しました。目撃者らは、球体が最初の位置から移動し、推定距離75ヤードで視界から消えたと推定した。この観察は「トライアングルオーブ」、「レッドオーブローテーション」、「池の上のオーブ」から40マイル以内で発生しており、彼らにとってはよく知られている人口の少ない場所での目撃である。上記の説明は、事件の目撃者によって連邦捜査局 (FBI) に提供された陳述に基づいています。 FBI は、この事件を報告した個人を信頼できると評価しています。ファイル FBI-UAP-D009 から FBI-UAP-D010 に記述され、ビデオ映像 FBI-UAP-PR004 に描かれている主題は、米国北東部の同じ一般地域から発信された報告に対応しています。

ICA-UAP-D001, Analysis: Colorado Springs UAP Incident, 2022
ICA-UAP-D001、分析: コロラドスプリングス UAP インシデント、2022 年
Intelligence Community Agency
6/12/26
2022
Colorado Springs, Colorado, U.S.
PDF
This document contains analysis by an All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO) Intelligence Community (IC) partner to account for a 2022 incident involving an airborne object near Colorado Springs, Colorado. U.S. military service members reported the incident to AARO in 2023. AARO’s IC partner assessed, with low confidence, that the reported phenomenon, which observers characterized as resembling an “angular, non-symmetrical potato,” was attributable to sunlight backscattering, where sunlight reflecting from mountain snow cover illuminated the underside of low-altitude clouds. This low-confidence assessment contributes to AARO’s consideration of the incident, which remains unresolved as of June 2026.
この文書には、コロラド州コロラドスプリングス近郊で発生した空中物体に関する 2022 年の事件を説明するための、全ドメイン異常解決局 (AARO) インテリジェンス コミュニティ (IC) パートナーによる分析が含まれています。米軍関係者は2023年にこの事件をAAROに報告した。AAROのICパートナーは、観測者が「角張った非対称のジャガイモ」に似ていると特徴付けた報告された現象は、山の積雪から反射した太陽光が低高度の雲の下面を照らす太陽光後方散乱に起因すると低い信頼性で評価した。この信頼度の低い評価は、2026 年 6 月の時点でも未解決のままであるこの事件についての AARO の検討に貢献します。

2022年2月15日0935 MNT、フォートカーソンの5名の米陸軍要員がコロラド州チェイエン山上空約6マイル西方、山裾約300–500フィート上空にほぼ静止した飛行物体を約30–180秒間観測した。目撃者は物体を大型機大の角ばった非対称の「ジャガイモ」状、やや半透明で白くきらめき太陽光を反射すると描写したが、観測中に突如消失した。現地の太陽は南東で高度約27.5度、方位約125度にあり、チェイエン山の積雪深は過去報告で約6–12インチと推定される一方、気象報告は当該朝を部分〜概ね多雲と示している。解析は、雪面からの太陽光後方散乱が低層雲を照らし目撃された「物体」を説明し得ると結論付けたが、目撃者の視野、積雪量、高度や雲量の不確かさにより確信度は低い。異常なデータや敵対的能力の示唆はなく、当時周辺での航空機や気球の活動は確認されていない。
On 15 February 2022 at 0935 MNT, five U.S. Army service members at Fort Carson observed an airborne object about 6 miles west of Cheyenne Mountain, roughly 300–500 ft above the mountain, remaining nearly stationary for approximately 30–180 seconds before suddenly disappearing. Witnesses described the object as roughly the size of a large jet, angular and non‑symmetrical, slightly translucent and shimmering white, reflecting sunlight. At ~0945 MST the sun was about 27.5° altitude at azimuth ~125°, and historical reports indicate snow depth on Cheyenne Mountain of about 6–12 inches; some weather sources indicated partly to mostly cloudy conditions that morning. Analysis concluded the observation was possibly due to backscattering of sunlight off snow illuminating low‑level clouds, but the assessment has low confidence because of uncertainties in witness fields of view, snow cover, exact elevation, and cloud cover. No anomalous characteristics or indications of an adversarial capability were recorded, and no aircraft or balloons were noted in the area at that time.

CIA-UAP-002, Scientific Advisory Panel on Unidentified Flying Objects, Report, 1952-1953
CIA-UAP-002、未確認飛行物体に関する科学諮問委員会、報告書、1952-1953
CIA
6/12/26
1952-1953
PDF
This file contains correspondence and reports dated 1952–1953 from the Scientific Advisory Panel on Unidentified Flying Objects, convened by the CIA’s Office of Scientific Intelligence. The panel’s primary conclusion was that “flying saucers” did not pose a direct physical threat to the national security of the United States. The panel found no evidence that these phenomena were attributable to hostile foreign artifacts or indicated a need to revise existing scientific concepts. However, the panel identified a significant indirect threat stemming from the public’s fascination with the subject. The panel concluded that the high volume of reports, encouraged by a "sensationalist press," could overwhelm and clog vital intelligence and communication channels, potentially distracting from genuine threats. Furthermore, they warned that a “morbid national psychology” could be exploited by adversaries to incite “hysterical behavior and harmful distrust of duly constituted authority.” To mitigate these risks, the panel recommended an official policy of “debunking” to “strip the UFO subject of its mystery,” alongside a training initiative for military personnel to better recognize and filter out misidentified objects, thereby reducing communication “noise” and allowing the national security apparatus to focus on more "legitimate defense concerns."
このファイルには、CIA 科学情報局が招集した未確認飛行物体に関する科学諮問委員会からの 1952 年から 1953 年の日付の通信と報告書が含まれています。パネルの主な結論は、「空飛ぶ円盤」は米国の国家安全保障に直接の物理的脅威をもたらさないというものだった。委員会は、これらの現象が敵対的な外国の人工物に起因するという証拠は見つからず、既存の科学的概念を修正する必要性を示していませんでした。しかし、委員会は、この主題に対する国民の関心から生じる重大な間接的な脅威を特定しました。委員会は、「センセーショナリズム的な報道機関」によって奨励された大量の報道は、重要な情報とコミュニケーションチャネルを圧倒し、詰まり、真の脅威から目をそらす可能性があると結論付けた。さらに、「病的な国民心理」が敵対者によって悪用され、「ヒステリックな行動や、正当に構成された権威に対する有害な不信感」を煽る可能性があると警告した。これらのリスクを軽減するために、委員会は、「UFOという主題からその謎を取り除く」ための「誤りを暴く」公式政策と、誤認された物体をよりよく認識して除外するための軍関係者向けの訓練イニシアチブを推奨し、それによって通信の「ノイズ」を減らし、国家安全保障機関がより「正当な防衛上の懸念」に集中できるようにした。

1953年1月17日付の「科学顧問パネルによる未確認飛行物体（UFO）に関する報告」を、中枢情報局（DCI）関係者が3月12–13日に政府関係者へ送付した文書群。パネルは諸情報（主に空軍技術情報センターの資料）を検討し、UFO現象が国家安全保障に対する直接的な物理的脅威を示す証拠はないと結論付けた。一方で、報告強調により通報経路が無関係な報告で混雑し、誤報連続によって真の敵対的事象を見落とす危険や、敵の宣伝による社会不安・権威への不信を助長する可能性を指摘した。勧告として、UFOに付与された特別扱いや神秘性を排し、情報収集・訓練・公衆教育政策を実施して国民の防御力と士気を高め、迅速な評価・対応のための通常のルートを強化すること、並びに統合的プログラムで公衆を安心させ、担当要員を誤報の識別に訓練することを提案している。報告は情報諸機関および国防長官、連邦民間防護局長などに配布された。文書送付者としてRICHARD D. DRAIN（Intelligence Advisory Committee事務局長名義）や受領者にVal Petersonらの氏名が記載され、パネル署名者にLloyd V. Berkner、B. P. Robertson（議長）、S. A. Goudsmit、Luis W. Alvarezらの名が見える。
Documents dated March 12–13, 1953 transmit a January 17, 1953 “Report of the Scientific Panel on Unidentified Flying Objects” to senior officials. The panel, having reviewed evidence (primarily from the Air Technical Intelligence Center), concluded there is no indication that UFO phenomena constitute a direct physical threat to national security and found no evidence attributing cases to foreign hostile artifacts or requiring revision of scientific concepts. The panel warned that emphasis on reporting UFOs can clog communication channels with irrelevant reports, create a risk that repeated false alarms will cause real indications to be ignored, and foster a morbid national psychology exploitable by hostile propaganda. Recommendations include stripping UFOs of special mystique, instituting intelligence, training, and public-education policies to prepare defenses and morale, training personnel to recognize and reject false indications, and strengthening regular channels for evaluation and prompt reaction through an integrated program to reassure the public. documents.summaryText:
日付: 1958年1月9日。電話でDr. Davidsonに対し、いわゆる「spice message」とその送信機に関する問題は解決できないと伝えた。理由は送信機に関する記録が（文書中判読不能な）機関によって破棄されているためであり、Davidsonはこの説明を受け入れ、以前に同様の説明を受けていたこと、同件に関する公開用の別の記事は所持していないことを認めた。報告はまた、この放送には多くの関係者が介在しており、その結果としてDavidsonに対して与えるよう指示された回答が非コミットで迂遠なものになったことを示している（これは我々自身や他の関係機関の以前の陳述と矛盾しないようにするための措置であった）が、その回答はDavidsonにとって公平とは言えず完全には受け入れられない可能性があると述べている。電話でのやりとりでは、記録上DavidsonがWalkerおよびSmithと連絡を取っていたことを知っていたことを示すものはなく、実際には彼らの身元を隠す努力がなされていたことが示された。Court of Appeals Buildingでの面談ではDavidsonは扱っている事柄をよく理解していたようであり、Davidson–Halfountain間の電話会話でDavidsonが特定の人名を言及したことが記録されている。最後に、Davidsonからさらに連絡があるだろうと結んでいる。
Date: January 9, 1958. By telephone staff advised Dr. Davidson that they could not resolve his problem concerning the "spice message" and its transmitter because records on the transmitter had been destroyed by a (textually illegible) agency. Davidson accepted this explanation, acknowledged he had been told this previously, and stated he did not have a second article for publication on the matter; he hinted he might raise the issue again later. The report states that many parties had been involved with this transmission, and as a result the noncommittal/evasive answers staff were instructed to give Davidson were intended to avoid contradicting prior statements by themselves and other involved agencies; however, those answers were judged hardly fair to Davidson and unlikely to be fully accepted by him. Telephone exchanges disclosed no record showing Davidson knew he had been dealing with Walker and Smith in prior contacts; in fact efforts had been made to conceal their identities. At the Court of Appeals Building interview Davidson appeared to understand well what he was dealing with, and a Davidson–Halfountain telephone conversation included Davidson mentioning a specific person. The memo concludes that further word will be heard from Davidson.

This CIA information report from November 1955 describes a US national's eyewitness account of triangular aircraft with wing lights launch at a steep angle from an airfield near Baku, Azerbaijan on October 4, 1955. A redacted version of this report has been available on CIA's public website.
この 1955 年 11 月の CIA 情報報告書には、1955 年 10 月 4 日にアゼルバイジャンのバクー近郊の飛行場から翼灯を備えた三角形の航空機が急な角度で離陸した米国人の目撃証言が記載されています。この報告書の編集版は CIA の公開ウェブサイトで入手可能です。

documents.summaryText:
情報は未評価。情報提供者は41歳の米国人企業役員で、技術的航空知識はない。1955年10月4日16:30頃、バクー発トビリシ行き列車内からアゼルバイジャンSSR付近（バクーの南約50–65マイル、観測者の後の修正で対象物まで約2マイル）で、カスピ海沿岸側の大飛行場に格納された正三角形状でずんぐりした物体を目撃したと報告。物体は各頂点に灯があり（計3灯）、ジェット戦闘機に匹敵する大きさとされた。物体は発射され、空中で3〜7回の高速らせん運動を行ったのち約45度で急上昇し高高度に達した。サーチライトが追跡し、目撃中に車掌がブラインドを下ろした（MVDの指示と示唆）。同行者はこれが短時間に続けて行われた2回目の発射であると述べた。報告は観光旅行中の証言に基づく。
This is unevaluated information. The source is a 41-year-old U.S. national, a corporate publicity/advertising vice president with no technical aviation training. On 4 Oct 1955 at about 1630, while on a train from Baku to Tiflis in the Azerbaijan SSR, he observed from the left side of the train an equilateral-triangle, squat object on a large airfield between the train and the Caspian Sea (observer later revised distance to the object to about 2 miles; he estimated the train was 50–65 miles south of Baku). The object, roughly the size of a U.S. jet fighter, had three lights (one at each apex). It was ejected/launched, made 3–7 rapid spirals in the air, then climbed steeply at about a 45° angle to high altitude while a searchlight followed it. The source described the launch as missile-like; a companion reported this was the second launch in quick succession. During observation a steward pulled the blinds down—apparently at the direction of an MVD man who had boarded at departure.

At the Origins of Life conference in Yerevan, Armenia (6–8 Sep 1971), Kardashev and coauthor Andrei D. Sakharov presented a speculative paper based on general relativity about collapse of a charged mass. They argued that an uncharged mass would collapse past a gravitational singularity and disappear, whereas a charged mass could bounce and re-emerge in a different region of space–time. Sakharov was primarily interested because this suggests a more complex structure of space; Kardashev was interested in possible astrophysical implications. A U.S. attendee considered the speculation somewhat fantastic but thought it was grounded in sound physics; the report is a summary from a reliable U.S. citizen attendee.

This CIA document from August 1967 reports on conversations about UFO sightings with Soviet scientists during a US astrophysicist's trip to the USSR.
1967年8月のこのCIA文書は、米国の天体物理学者のソ連訪問中にソ連の科学者とUFO目撃についての会話を報告している。
既に公開済み
documents.summaryText:
1967年5月、米国人天体物理学者（大研究所の職員）が旧ソ連内の複数天文台を1か月訪問し、UFOに関する会話を記録した未評価情報の報告。主な所見：モロズ（スターンベルク研）は問題に無頓着、通訳の無線天文学者はソ連での目撃を知らないと発言。プルコヴォではコーカサス近傍の目撃の話を聞いた女性天文学者が心を開いていた。コジレフ（N.A. Kozyrev）は強い関心を示し、メンゼルの著作を読んで結論を受け入れず、ソ連北部での目撃を知り、個人的には金星起源の可能性を示唆、新聞掲載はされないと述べた。キエフではI.K. Kovalらが赤っぽい飛行物を目撃し再突入破片と解釈したがUFOの存在を否定しなかった。クリミアのL.I. Galkinも同観測を確認し「円盤」の可能性に触れた。アルマアタの天文研究所では当初所長G.M. Idlisがメンゼルを評価して問題は閉じているとしたが、米国のMcDonaldらの批判的研究を示すと未解決と認めた。大気光学のG.S. Lifschitzは重要性をあまり認めずつつも若干の興味が生じる可能性を示した。北カザフでの「球電」目撃は逆転層での自動車ヘッドライト反射と判明。恒星分光学者Dr. Kupoも追加研究の余地を認めた。総括としてソ連に公式対応はなく、研究者は主に米国のメンゼル報告を引いて問題の不存在を示す傾向にあるが、現象の認識と関心は広く、米国の説明の不備を示す証拠があればソ連側の関心は急速に高まる可能性がある。
A US astrophysicist visited several Soviet astronomical institutes in May 1967 and reported conversations about unidentified flying objects (unevaluated information). Key points: V.I. Moroz (Sternberg Institute) was noncommittal; a translating radio astronomer said he knew of no Soviet sightings. At Pulkovo an astronomer had heard of sightings near the Caucasus and was open-minded. N.A. Kozyrev was highly interested, had read Menzel (in Russian) but rejected its conclusions, knew of sightings in the USSR north, said such reports are not printed in Soviet newspapers, and personally considered a Venus origin possible. At Kiev, I.K. Koval and others saw a reddish object they thought might be reentering satellite/rocket debris but did not rule out UFOs. L.I. Galkin at the Crimean Observatory confirmed the sighting and considered a 'saucer' possibility. At the Astrophysical Institute in Alma-Ata, director G.M. Idlis initially judged Menzel adequate but, after hearing McDonald’s critical study, called the question still open; G.S. Lifschitz was unimpressed by Menzel and by the phenomenon’s significance though some interest might be kindled. Reports of repeated ball-lightning in northern Kazakhstan were traced to car-headlight reflections from an inversion layer. Dr. Kupo saw research opportunities. Overall, there is no official Soviet treatment; researchers often cite US work (mainly Menzel) to argue no scientific problem, yet awareness and interest are widespread and evidence undermining US explanations could quickly stimulate greater Soviet scientific enthusiasm.

documents.summaryText:
1952年12月18日付メモ。英国からの伝言によれば、約16か月前に設置された“未確認飛行物体”に関する常設委員会があり、R.V. Jonesが中心人物となっている。委員会は観測された物体が敵機ではなく、英国上空を飛行した事例はないと結論付けているが、ヨークシャー事件で高官やRAF搭乗員が「完璧な飛行円盤」を目撃し、報道が出たためJonesは公論形成の管理を懸念している。旅行者は米海軍下士官が撮影したフィルム（Tremonton事件）に言及しており、Jonesがそのコピーや追加情報を求める可能性がある。別紙では、これらの目撃が直ちに防衛上の直接的脅威を示す証拠はないが、（1）識別遅延による早期警報機能の弱体化、（2）敵が偽報で誘発する恐れのある集団ヒステリー、（3）緊急通信の過負荷といった潜在的危険を挙げ、集団ヒステリーはFCDAやICISに、通信過負荷は各軍が対処すべきとして、合同通信・電子委員会で議題化する計画を示している。
Memorandum dated 18 December 1952 concerning British activity on "unidentified flying objects." A standing British committee established about sixteen months earlier, now under R. V. Jones, has concluded sightings are not enemy aircraft and none have flown over Britain. A recent Yorkshire incident involved a demonstration attended by high RAF officials who, along with pilots and members of the public, reportedly saw a "perfect flying saucer," prompting Jones' concern about managing public opinion. The traveler mentioned a film taken by a U.S. naval non‑commissioned officer (Tremonton incident); Jones may request a copy or further information. The memo notes no indication of a direct defense threat but lists potential dangers: (1) identification delays weakening early warning, (2) possible mass hysteria induced by faked reports, and (3) overload of emergency communications. It states these issues should be handled outside the intelligence community—mass hysteria via the FCDA/ICIS and communications overload examined by the individual services—and that the subject will be raised at the Joint Communications and Electronics Committee.

米中央情報局の情報報告（1968年2月〜3月）によると、ラダック、ネパール北東部、シッキム、ブータン各地で未確認飛行物体の目撃が相次いだ。主な事例：1968年2月19日、北東ネパールのWalungchung付近などで赤と緑の明滅を伴う細長い高速の物体が北東→南西方向に飛行、目撃後数秒で雷鳴のような音が聞かれた。同日ラチュン（Lachung）付近では尾部から光を発する物体が報告され、報告により進行方向は南東→北西あるいは北東→南西とされる。1968年2月21日21:30、ティンプー（ブータン）上空で青白い物体が東→西（あるいはチベット方向からの北東→南西）に無音で高速飛行し周辺を明るくした。1968年3月4日ラダックのChang La／Fukche／Koyul付近で白い光と同時に爆発音が2回聞かれ、赤い光の後に白煙が観測された。また同月および3月25日の目撃では、円形軌道を描く煙を伴う物体や、白〜黄白色の尾を引くロケット状の物体（高度約20,000–25,000フィート、尾長約20ヤードと記載）などが報告されている。文書冒頭には、エドワード・コンドン博士がコロラド大学を拠点とする空軍後援の民間UFO調査の責任者に任命された旨が記される。
A CIA information report covering February–March 1968 documents multiple sightings of unidentified flying objects over Ladakh, northeastern Nepal, Sikkim and western Bhutan. Key incidents: 19 Feb 1968 — near Walungchung and Ohurisa (NE Nepal), witnesses reported a long, thin, fast-moving object showing red and green brightness, flying NE→SW; thunder-like sounds were heard a few seconds after sighting. Also on 19 Feb, near Lachung, witnesses reported an object emitting light from its tail; reported flight directions vary (SE→NW or NE→SW). 21 Feb 1968, 21:30 — over Thimphu (Bhutan), a bluish object moved east→west (possibly NE→SW from Tibet), at high speed, silent, and bright enough to illuminate the area. 4 Mar 1968 — Chang La/Fukche/Koyul (Ladakh): a white light sighting accompanied by two blasting sounds and a red light followed by white smoke. Other reports in March describe objects on circular trajectories leaving smoke trails and, on 25 Mar, a rocket-like object with a white–yellow tail seen moving north→south toward Demchok, with an estimated altitude of about 20,000–25,000 ft and a tail length noted (~20 yards). The document also notes Dr. Edward Condon’s appointment as director of the Air Force‑sponsored civilian UFO investigation based at the University of Colorado, Boulder.

Dated to 1971, an Australian review of the USAF Project Blue Book. This document was released by the National Archives of Australia.
1971 年のオーストラリア空軍プロジェクト ブルーブックのレビュー。この文書はオーストラリア国立公文書館によって公開されました。
既に公開済み
documents.summaryText:
文書は米国のUFO調査に関する公式態度と経緯を概説している。1947年6月にオハイオのATICが飛行円盤報告の調査を引き受け、当初はソ連起源を疑ったが一部調査官は惑星間起源の可能性を検討し、1948年9月にペンタゴンへ書面見積を出した。1949年2月にProject SIGMAの人員が入れ替わりProject GRUDGEが設置され、UFO受容を打ち消す動きがあったが失敗し報告数はむしろ増加した。1952年3月のProject BLUE BOOK設立後は約3,200件の報告をIBMカードで処理し、1952年夏に報告件数が20倍超に増加、ワシントンD.C.付近での目撃も含まれた。1953年1月のロバートソン・パネルは調査継続（人員・装備増強）を勧告したが、同年2月のCIA報告は公的には調査を打ち切る一方で情報収集を強化する方針を示し、同年9月以降BLUE BOOKは大幅に縮小され調査機能は4602nd AISSに移管された。BLUE BOOKは1969年閉鎖まで主に非機密の要約提供にとどまり、真剣な収集・分析の中心とはならなかった。1953年のJANAP 146や1960年改訂の146Eで軍関係者の発言統制が強化され、退役後に米政府がUFOの地球外起源を知っていると公言した関係者（文書は複数名を列挙）もあった。Project BLUE BOOK特別報告No.14では一部の本文が公表されず、統計解析は「科学的に未知の説明」を支持する結果も示したと記されている。また、目撃者信頼性と報告の分類に関する図表では、目撃信頼性が上がるにつれて「不明」比率が増え、「情報不足」比率が減る傾向が示されている。文書の冒頭でオーストラリア側の調査能力不足（情報・科学・広報の観点）を補うため、RAAFの提案に基づき他の政府部門に調査責任を移すべきだとする見解も述べられている。
The document summarizes official U.S. attitudes and the history of UFO investigations. In June 1947 ATIC (near Dayton, Ohio) assumed responsibility for flying-saucer reports; investigators initially considered a Soviet origin but some favored an interplanetary explanation and a written estimate was sent to the Pentagon in September 1948. In February 1949 Project GRUDGE replaced earlier personnel with an effort to discourage acceptance of UFOs; this failed and reports increased. Project BLUE BOOK was established in March 1952, processed about 3,200 reports into IBM-card-sortable form, and the summer of 1952 saw a more-than-twenty-fold rise in reporting including major July sightings near Washington D.C. A Robertson panel (chaired by H.P. Robertson) in mid-January 1953 recommended continued investigation with increased staff and equipment, but a CIA report of 16 February 1953 favored publicly abandoning the investigation while intensifying data collection. By September 1953 BLUE BOOK was greatly reduced and investigative functions were transferred to the 4602nd AISS reporting to Air Defense Command and USAF Intelligence. BLUE BOOK remained largely a source of unclassified summaries until its closure in December 1969 and was not the central body for serious collection or analysis. JANAP 146 (1953) and its 1960 revision JANAP 146E tightened restrictions on service personnel discussing UFOs (with severe penalties). The document notes retired or resigning intelligence officers (named in the text) publicly stated the U.S. government knew UFOs were extraterrestrial but withheld this from the public. Project BLUE BOOK Special Report No.14 contained unreleased sections; statistical analysis in the report reportedly favored an explanation that was scientifically unknown, though public summaries emphasized reducing residual unknowns. A diagram in the report showed that as observer and report reliability improved, the percentage classified as “unknown” increased while “insufficient information” decreased. The file also includes an Australian note that Australia lacked adequate intelligence, scientific and public-relations perspectives on UFOs and that the RAAF suggested another government department assume investigation responsibility.

DOW-UAP-D077, AARO Unresolved Case Analysis Update: Western United States Event
DOW-UAP-D077、AARO 未解決事件分析の最新情報: 米国西部のイベント
Department of War
6/12/26
2023
Western United States
PDF
This memorandum summarizes the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office’s (AARO) ongoing analysis of a reported incident near a sensitive national security site in the western United States involving unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) over a period of two days in 2023. As of June 2026, the case remains unresolved.
この覚書は、2023 年の 2 日間に未確認の異常現象 (UAP) を伴う、米国西部の国家安全保障上の重要な拠点付近で報告された事件について、全ドメイン異常解決局 (AARO) が継続的に行っている分析を要約したものです。2026 年 6 月の時点で、この事件は未解決のままです。
初公開
documents.summaryText:
2023年10月の2日間、米国西部の機密国家安全保障施設付近で、連邦法執行機関の特殊捜査官6名（3チーム）が薄暮時に光るオレンジ色の「母オーブ」が複数回にわたり小さな赤い「オーブ」を放出するように見える現象を報告した。報告は複数視角からの類似した記述で一貫しており、赤いオーブは水平に協調して移動するように見えたり高度を変えたりし、数秒持続するケースや少なくとも1件で数時間静止したとされ、現象は「無音」と報告された。現場で映像・写真等の計測データは収集されていないため、距離・速度・大きさ・音の有無などは計器的に確定できないが、観察者の専門性と他地域事例との整合性を踏まえ、AAROは追加調査の必要性を認めている。初期解析で約60%は軍機による赤外線フレア等と整合する可能性が示されたが、残る約40%はレーダーやADS-Bで既知機の存在が確認できず、既知のフレアの燃焼特性とも整合しない観測が含まれるため未解決のままである。誤認（航空機排気、UAV）、自然現象、外国活動についてはそれぞれ除外または可能性が低いと評価され、米軍の既知能力（Blue Force）は部分的に整合するが決定的な記録はない。AAROは未認識技術の可能性を排除できないと暫定評価する一方、これは叙述証言と除外過程のみに基づくと明記している。今後は学術・政府のモデリングや多域・多スペクトルデータの統合、データ収集・分析手法の改善、関連機関との連携強化を進める予定である。
Over two days in October 2023, six federal special agents (three two-person teams) near a sensitive national security site in the western U.S. reported repeated observations of luminous orange "mother orbs" that appeared to emit clusters of smaller red "orbs". Reports from multiple viewing angles were highly consistent; the red orbs exhibited varied kinematics (coordinated horizontal motion, altitude changes), persisted for seconds in most cases and, in at least one report, remained stationary for several hours; observers described the phenomena as silent. No video, photographic, or other instrumented data were collected, so distance, size, speed, and acoustic characteristics cannot be instrumentally confirmed, but AARO judged contextual factors (observer expertise and regional similarity to other incidents) sufficient to justify further investigation. Initial analysis and cross-correlation with flight logs, radar, and ADS-B indicate roughly 60% of the reported activity is plausibly attributable to military aircraft dispensing infrared countermeasure flares, while about 40% remains unexplained because no known aircraft were present in observers’ lines of sight and some observations are inconsistent with known flare burn/descent characteristics. Misidentified aircraft exhaust and UAVs were assessed as unlikely or ruled out; natural/space phenomena and foreign intelligence activity were assessed as unlikely or highly unlikely; U.S. Blue Force capabilities partially align but historical records are inconclusive. AARO provisionally notes that unrecognized technology could account for up to ~40% of the observations, but this conclusion is based solely on narrative testimony and elimination of other hypotheses. AARO will continue investigation using scientific modeling, academic and interagency expertise, multispectral/multi-domain data integration, and improved data-collection and analytic protocols.

This memorandum records a first‑hand narrative from Witness 1, a U.S. federal law enforcement special agent, submitted to AARO. Witness 1 reported observing UAP over two nights in October 2023 in the western U.S. On the second night, while driving through a valley with a teammate, they observed a well‑defined circular glowing object (lava‑like swirl, bright at dusk), estimated >20 ft diameter, viewed for 1–2 minutes at an initial range estimate of 500–600 m (later rangefinder placed the hillside at ~1100 m). About 20 minutes later a similar orange ball briefly lit over another hillside; when lit, three red lights were seen departing it and a brief flash lit the sky to the left. A similar event recurred with a different departure pattern of the three red lights. Several hours later they observed a vehicle ahead that moved off the road and appeared to hover; its lights then turned off and a darker object ascended and departed. Later they observed dust and thick spider‑web‑like material and a similarly ambiguous, semi‑transparent object drifting 15–20 ft above ground through which stars and terrain were visible. No sound was reported.

AAROに提出された目撃者2（米連邦法執行官）の陳述（メモ日付2026-06-02）は、2023年10月に西部米国で2日間にわたり目撃した未確認異常現象（UAP）を記す。Incident 1: 約1900時、北〜北東の地平線上35–45度に明るいオーブ状光と内部の小赤オーブを観察。オーブが3–4個の赤い光を放出し、水平方向に編隊を組む動作を約5回繰り返した。最終の赤い光群は南の地平線上に留まり1930–2300時頃にかけてホバリングし、時折地平線の下に沈んで再出現した。音響・干渉・生理影響は報告されていない。Incident 2: 別日1800時前後、谷間で走行監視中に南方5–7マイルに静止する“ヘッドライト様”オーブと、約15度上空にフットボール場規模を覆う赤い光の列を観察。2つの“車両様”光が白色パルスで点滅し、一つが接近。目撃者らが夜間視界で追跡すると、光は白／橙のオーブに変化し瞬時に加速、滑空して山麓で消灯。その後箱状（トラック状）に変形し西側山脈へ短時間で高速移動して消え、同時に南の赤列も消失した。物体は地表20フィート以内に見え、接近に反応的で挙動は“模倣的”かつ物理法則と一致しないと報告。Incident 3: 2100–2300時の間、道路上に単一の明るいオーブを観察。追跡中にオーブは道路上をホバリングしながら移動し、時に赤テール様に変化、約10–15マイルにわたり追跡しても捕捉できず、最終的に橙色の円盤状に変化して路肩へ降下した。近接時にセミトラックらしき実車が接近し、そこで記述が途切れる。全件で音響・電子干渉・生理的影響はなしとされる。

This process repeated about five times between 1900–1930. The last red-light group moved to the southern horizon and hovered from ~1930–2300, occasionally dipping below and reappearing. No acoustic, interference, or physiological effects were reported. Incident 2: While surveying from ~1800, the witness observed two stationary orb‑like lights ~5–7 miles south and, by ~1900, a row of red lights hovering ~15° above the southern horizon covering a large area. Two vehicle‑like lights flashed white pulses; one moved north toward the witness. During pursuit with night vision, lights morphed into a bright white/orange orb with a halo, accelerated south across rugged terrain in under a minute, dimmed at a mountain base, later reappeared as a box‑shaped cluster of orange/purple lights resembling a semi‑truck, then glided ~4 miles in ~1 minute toward the western range and disappeared; the red row also vanished. Objects in the valley appeared within ~20 feet of the ground, highly responsive to the witnesses, mimicked vehicle shapes, and exhibited controlled movements the witness described as inconsistent with known physics. Incident 3: Between ~2100–2300 the witness observed a single bright orb on a road crest 1–2 miles NW; it hovered and traveled west along the road at vehicle height with a single center light, intermittently appearing as a red taillight, and maintained that behavior for ~10–15 miles while the witness, driving ~80 mph, could not catch it. The object later transformed into an orange orb/disk and moved to the road shoulder; a semi‑truck appeared as they neared and the account is truncated. No acoustic, interference, or physiological effects were reported.

First-hand statement from Witness 3 (a U.S. federal law enforcement special agent) provided to AARO. Two sightings in mid‑October 2023 in the western U.S. First event: ~1900, dusk, clear sky—witness observed a large orange orb in the east that alternated between clear and orange every ~2–3 seconds, moved ~20 degrees in ~3–5 seconds, and at ~45 degrees expelled three smaller red orbs in a manner described as mechanical. The red orbs traveled south in a straight line, spaced ~1 second apart, maintaining ~45 degrees until no longer visible. No sound or exhaust trails were recalled. Duration ~30–45 seconds. Second event: same or next night, ~2000–2030, near full darkness, witness using NVGs saw red lights from the north moving south across ~90 degrees in ~5–10 seconds; four red lights hovered above an airfield forming a square over the corners. Around the same time orange orbs (possibly two) hovered near a west‑facing ridgeline. A vehicle below flashed headlights at ~2–3 second intervals; when the witnesses drove down (lights off, using NVGs) the vehicle maintained ~100 yards distance, then appeared to float off the road south across rough terrain. No tire tracks were later found; the vehicle was seen in brush with a single light that faded, and when the vehicle disappeared the orbs were gone. Duration ~2–3 minutes. Document dated 2 June 2026, signed by the AARO Director. No speculation included.

Witness 4（米国連邦法執行特殊捜査官）は、2023年10月に西部米国で複数夜にわたり目撃したUAP現象をAAROに報告した。最初の夜、日没直後に地上1–2k付近を横切る明るい球状光を目撃し、その後裸眼および夜間視覚ゴーグルで様々な明るさの橙色の光（単独球、三つ並び、水平に等間隔の九つの静止光など）を観察した。大型の非常に明るい橙色光から小さな光が“孵化”して下方へ落ちるように見える現象や、光が出現・消滅を繰り返す様子が2–3時間にわたり継続した。翌晩は尾根付近で白い“ケムトレイル様”痕跡が観察され、1本がUターンして急降下、同時に飛行機やStarlink様の光列も見られた。山間で光が頂上と麓を短時間で行き来しながら塵を巻き上げない移動や、尾根下に非常に明るい安定した白色光が現れて接近時に消え、夜間深夜帯に複数の光が集まりダイヤモンドや六角形などのパターンを形成することも報告している。別日に高度約6kでホバリング・水平移動する複数光や、山稜間に静止し赤い弱光を伴う実体のように見える物体（約400m離れた位置）を観察した。数か月後には目線高さの黄光が北→南に短時間で移動したとし、騒音や排気の観察はなかったと記している。
Witness 4 (a U.S. federal law-enforcement special agent) provided a first‑hand account to AARO of multiple nights of UAP observations in the western U.S. in October 2023. On the first night just after sunset they saw a bright ball of light ~1–2k above ground, then multiple orange/orb lights by naked eye and with NVGs, including groups arranged as lines of three and a horizontal line of nine static lights visible for 30+ seconds. They reported repeated “hatching” events where very bright orange lights emitted smaller orange lights that descended like flares, and many lights appeared and disappeared over a continuous 2–3 hour period. The next night they observed white, trail‑like plumes rising from a ridge (one making a U‑turn and rapidly descending), a plane and a Starlink‑like string of lights, and a light that produced four smaller lights which descended and formed patterns. They also described lights moving rapidly between mountain tops and bases without kicking up dust, a very bright steady white light below a ridgeline that vanished when approached while a similar light appeared elsewhere, and repeated clustering of lights into geometric shapes (diamonds/hexagons). On other occasions they observed multiple lights hovering/moving at ~6k altitude and an object with a faint red light hovering between ridges at ~400 m distance. DOW-UAP-D083、ナラティブ ステートメント 5、米国西部イベント、2023 年

This memorandum presents the first-hand narrative from Witness 5 provided to the All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office (AARO). Witness 5 was one of several United States (U.S.) federal law enforcement special agents who reported observing unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP) over a period of two days in October 2023 in the western United States.
この覚書は、全ドメイン異常解決局 (AARO) に提供された証人 5 からの直接の話を紹介します。目撃者 5 は、2023 年 10 月に米国西部で 2 日間にわたって未確認の異常現象 (UAP) を観察したと報告した数人の米国連邦法執行特別捜査官のうちの 1 人でした。

documents.summaryText:
本メモ（2026年6月2日付）はAAROに提出された証人5の一次記述をまとめたもので、証人は2023年10月に米国西部で2日間にわたり未確認異常現象を観察したと報告している。10月の夜間行動では、約1858に尾根上方で抵抗なくホバリングする大きなオレンジ色の光を観測。1918頃には大きな赤いオーブから同時に放出される小さな赤色オーブ2個を目撃し、約10秒で消滅、直後に西方で白い閃光を見た。1937にも大きなオーブを再観測し、さらにカメラを設置して待機した。通信は断続的で他チームとは聞こえ方に差があった。最終日の深夜〜早朝には地表約2–3ft上に白四角光と赤丸光のペアを観測、ホバリング後に消灯しNVGでは幅約4ftの薄い水平線状の残像が15–20mphで移動するのを確認。約0530頃にはNVGで“クモの巣”様の浮遊物と、それに続いて20ft超の高さで完全な配列を成す薄暗い灯列が移動するのを裸眼およびNVGで同時に観察し、短時間で減光・消失した。車両位置やタイヤ痕は目撃地点と一致し、翌朝の現場調査で特定の植物周囲に鋭く新しい左右対称の擦り傷（必ずしも円形でない）を確認している。報告書はJon T. Kosloski（AARO所長）名で締められている。
This memorandum (2 June 2026) records Witness 5’s first‑hand narrative to AARO. Witness 5, a U.S. federal law‑enforcement special agent, reported two days of UAP observations in western U.S. in October 2023. On the first night at ~1858 they observed a large orange light hovering over a ridge for under a minute. At ~1918 they saw a large red orb that released two smaller red orbs moving away; all lights extinguished in about 10 seconds and a white flash was seen to the west. The large orb was seen again at ~1937; a camera was later deployed about 3 miles from the vehicle. Radio communications were intermittent and other teams could not consistently hear them. In the pre‑dawn hours (~0430) they observed a white square and a red round light pair ~2–3 ft above ground hovering over bushes; after lights went out NVGs revealed a thin horizontal line ~4 ft wide moving at ~15–20 mph. Around ~0530 NVGs and naked eye both observed floating cobweb‑like material and a faint formation of lights moving together over 20 ft high; the formation reappeared at a different angle then faded. Thermal searches found “cold” spots that were not explanatory. Vehicle/tire tracks corresponded to the sighting location, and at daylight investigators found fresh, sharp, often symmetric scrape marks in the soil around a particular plant. Document signed by Jon T. Kosloski, Director, AARO.

This file contains a copy of the CIA's 1953 "Report of the Scientific Panel on Unidentified Flying Objects" that was sent to the Secretary of Defense.
このファイルには、国防長官に送信された CIA の 1953 年の「未確認飛行物体に関する科学パネル報告書」のコピーが含まれています。
既に公開済み
documents.summaryText:
1953年3月13日付でCIA（Richard D. Drain）が国防長官宛に送付した、科学者パネルによる「未確認飛行物体（UFO）」に関する報告書（パネル会合日：1953年1月17日）の要約。パネルは科学情報担当副所長の依頼で、主にAir Technical Intelligence Center等の資料と文書化された事例を検討した。結論として、提示された証拠はUFOが国家安全保障に対する直接的な物理的脅威を構成することを示しておらず、外国製の敵対的装置や現行科学概念の見直しを要する証拠はないとした。一方、UFO報告の強調は通信路の混雑、誤警報による真の兆候の見落とし、国民心理の病的変化や敵の宣伝に悪用されうる危険など、秩序ある防護機能の妨げとなると指摘した。勧告は、国家安全保障機関がUFOに付された特別視や神秘性を取り除くこと、情報・訓練・公教育の方針を整備して物的防御と士気を高め、誤報を速やかに排除し真の敵対行動に迅速対応できる体制を構築するための統合プログラムを実施すること、である。報告書には署名者（H. P. Robertsonほか複数）と、関係のルーティング指示・機密表示が含まれる。
A CIA cover memorandum dated March 13, 1953, forwarded to the Secretary of Defense a Report of the Scientific Panel on Unidentified Flying Objects (panel date: January 17, 1953). The panel, convened at the request of the Assistant Director for Scientific Intelligence (and at General Smith’s direction following the Intelligence Advisory Committee recommendation), reviewed evidence provided mainly by the Air Technical Intelligence Center and selected well-documented cases. It concluded that the available evidence shows no indication that UFOs constitute a direct physical threat to national security, that there is no residue of cases attributable to foreign hostile artifacts, and no need to revise current scientific concepts. The panel warned, however, that continued emphasis on UFO reporting can clog communications, produce false alarms that might cause real indicators to be ignored, and foster a morbid national psychology exploitable by hostile propaganda. Recommendations called for national security agencies to remove the special/mysterious status of UFOs and to implement integrated policies on intelligence, training, and public education to reassure the public, train personnel to reject false indications, and strengthen normal channels for timely evaluation and response to genuine hostile actions. The file includes signatures of panel members (e.g., H. P. Robertson, Lloyd V. Berkner, S. A. Goudsmit, Luis W. Alvarez, Thornton Page) and routing/classification markings.

documents.summaryText:
1948年12月13日付、第五海区司令部発の通報。件名は「Flying Discs」に関する報告で、参照として海軍作戦長官（CNO）機密書簡（Op-322V P16-3/QN, Serial 0442P32, 1948年11月4日付）を引用している。引用文は、米空軍情報局長が「Flying Discs」の再出現サイクルが現れつつあり新たな周期の始まりが差し迫っていると海軍省に通知したこと、目撃は速やかに報告し調査するよう要請していること、各基地は最寄りの空軍司令部および海軍地区情報部に報告し写真証拠を得ることが望ましいこと、DIOは情報を海軍情報長官に転送し海軍情報長官が米空軍情報局長に最速で伝達することを指示している点を伝えている。配布リストや配布部数（85部）等の管理情報、受領印（1948年12月15日）等の書き込みがある。
Memorandum from the Commandant, Fifth Naval District dated 13 Dec 1948 concerning reports of "Flying Discs." It quotes a Chief of Naval Operations letter (Op-322V P16-3/QN, Serial 0442P32, 4 Nov 1948) stating that the USAF Director of Intelligence informed the Navy that a cycle of reappearance of "Flying Discs" is becoming apparent and a new interval is imminent. The CNO letter requests prompt reporting and investigation of sightings, reporting to the nearest Air Force Command and the Naval District Intelligence Office, obtaining photographic evidence when possible, and routing DIO reports to the Chief of Naval Intelligence for rapid transmission to the USAF Director of Intelligence. The file includes distribution list details (85 copies) and annotations/received stamps (e.g., 15 Dec 1948).

This document is a Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) FD-302, a form the FBI uses to record interviews. This FD-302 contains a summary of an interview with a U.S. military service member in March 2025 regarding a February 2022 incident potentially involving unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAP). The individual described the phenomenon as being “bean shaped,” “matte white” or “off-white” in color, with a surface covered in “intersecting lines or ridges which formed an abstract polygon pattern.” The individual described the phenomenon as “motionless” and that “no sound could be heard coming from it.” FBI Note: AARO has since been in contact with the interviewee to conduct subsequent interviews to inform its analysis of this incident.

2025年3月にMicrosoft Teamsで実施された面談で、被面談者は2022年2月上旬の平日午後1〜2時頃、Fort Carson付近でUAPを目撃したと述べた。被面談者を含む同一部隊の計5名で移動・徒歩中、Cheyanne Mountainの鞍部上方に静止しているように見える物体を全員が確認した。物体はつや消し白またはオフホワイトで非金属的に見え、水平の楕円（「豆型」）で底面に湾曲した窪みがあり、表面は交差する線や隆起で覆われ抽象的な多角形模様を呈していた。音はなく、観察は約3～5分続き、その間山の鞍部に対する位置は変わらなかったとされる。5名は携帯を持っておらず、一瞬目をそらして戻ると物体は消失していた。彼らは現象を議論し、飛行船や気象気球の可能性を検討、各自が独立して描いた図は一貫して同様の外観を示した。被面談者は誰かが陸軍に公式報告したと考え、AAROから2024年初めに連絡を受けて回答を提出したが、直接の聞き取りは受けていないと述べた。
In a March 2025 Microsoft Teams interview, the interviewee reported a UAP sighting in early February 2022 around 1–2 PM near Fort Carson. Five members of the interviewee’s unit observed an object appearing to hover over a saddle on Cheyanne Mountain. The object was described as matte white/off‑white, non‑metallic, horizontally oriented and oval/“bean‑shaped” with a curved indentation on the bottom; its surface had intersecting lines/ridges forming an abstract polygonal pattern. It made no sound and was observed for approximately 3–5 minutes without changing position relative to the saddle. None of the five had phones; when they briefly looked away to retrieve a phone, the object had vanished and could not be relocated. They later discussed possibilities (e.g., blimp, weather balloon) and independently produced consistent drawings. The interviewee believes someone filed an official Army report and stated AARO contacted him in early 2024; he provided a response but was not interviewed by AARO or others.

FBI documentation records contact with a redacted individual who reported repeated observations of unknown UxS/UAP appearing as plasma-like orbs near their residence and provided multiple video clips in October 2024. The individual’s first reported observation was in early November 2021; sightings have occurred as close as ~200 yards from the residence, with objects hovering or moving, observed above the horizon, within trees, near the ground, and at/near water. The reporter deployed trail cameras and other sensors, and reported gamma radiation spikes correlated with sighting times and additional anomalies affecting electronics and GPS. The reporter stated they were a skeptic before November 2021, wish to protect their family’s privacy and do not want the information public, and noted a south-side neighbor also reported strange lights. The matter was referred to the FBI in August 2024 and the information was shared to establish local contact and potential ongoing engagement.

documents.summaryText:
FBIのFD-1057記録。2024年10月にFBIで匿名の被面談者が面談を受けた。被面談者は現職の雇用先と主な勤務施設を述べ、FBIへ既に提供されたプレゼンテーションと映像について言及した。2021年に自宅で午前約5時に最初のUAP目撃を経験し、単一の光が2–3つに分かれて中央に光のある三角形状を約10分間維持したと報告。スマートフォンで撮影中にフラッシュを誤って発し、光が消えたと述べた。2022年の別の目撃や、夕暮れや夜間に光が形を変えて側方に動く事例があると説明。LinkedIn経由で他者と連絡を取り「人々が傷つけられてきた」と警告された旨の会話や、1996年に車両が停止し強い光に照らされたという過去の出来事の申告も含まれる。被面談者は2021年から現住所に居住し、以前の居住地から合計で何百回もの光を観測し、複数の写真・動画を保有していると主張した。9月以降活動が増え、短時間の出現や録画が破損することが多いと述べた。目撃が航空機であるか検証するため、ADSBデータと日時・方位を照合して確認したと説明し、自身はUAPに元々関心があったわけではないと認めた。ケースIDは「Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon / Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon」。
FBI FD-1057 electronic communication. In October 2024 an anonymized subject was interviewed at the FBI. The subject, employed at a named organization and working at a specific facility (redacted), discussed presentations and videos previously provided to the FBI. The subject reported a first UAP sighting in 2021 around 5 a.m. at home: a single light that split into two or three lights forming a triangular pattern with a center light, remaining for about ten minutes; the lights disappeared after an accidental flash photo. The subject referenced a separate March 2022 sighting and characterized sightings as typically at dusk or night with lights that morph and move laterally. The subject contacted another individual via LinkedIn who told them the observations were real and warned that “people have been hurt by these things,” and recounted a 1996 incident in New Mexico where a vehicle reportedly shut down and a large light illuminated occupants for about two minutes. The subject has lived at the current property since 2021 (previously ~5 miles away), claims to have observed hundreds of such lights and possesses numerous photos/videos willing to share; others have also observed them. Activity reportedly increased since September, with shorter bursts and frequent video corruption when recording. The subject used ADSB data to cross-check timestamps and azimuths to rule out aircraft and stated they were not previously interested in UAPs and that their statements may seem odd. Case ID notes Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon / Unidentified Anomalous Phenomenon.

件名: 11/1/2024 の現地調査（事件IDは伏せられている）。添付は複数の樹林・トレイルカメラ・裏デッキ写真および写真ログ。調書によれば、対象者（氏名・地名は伏せられている）は過去3年間にわたる未確認航空現象（UAP）目撃があったとして自身の所有地を捜査官に案内した。捜査官は自宅から約200ヤードの森林内に設置された西向きのトレイルカメラを確認し、このカメラがUAP活動を記録したと記載されている。現地には狩猟・釣り禁止を示す表示や南北に走る石塀があった。対象者は周辺の小道や、自身が観察した地点へ視界を持つ東側の複数住宅について説明した。対象者は該当の動画の写しを提供し、所有地へ機材を設置してライブまたはタイムラプス撮影することに協力的で、UAPがよく観察される夕方に捜査官と日程を調整すると述べている。
Title/Date: Site survey dated 11/1/2024 (case ID redacted). Enclosures include multiple treeline photos, trail camera photos, back-deck photos and a photo log. The subject (names/locations redacted) toured agents around the property where UAP sightings have occurred over the past three years and led them to a wooded area about 200 yards from the subject's home with a west-facing trail camera that has captured UAP activity. The site contained signs restricting hunting/fishing and a stone wall running south-to-north. The subject identified nearby trails and noted that the trail does not run through the observed area, and that multiple homes east of the site appear to have line of sight to the UAP observation area. The subject provided a copy of a video and said they are willing to allow equipment (live or time-lapse) to be set up on the property and to coordinate agent visits in the evening when UAP activity is often observed.

Additional observations from the treeline west of the residence included white/blue pulsing lights that appeared more stationary and broad plumes of light followed by red or white flashes that moved erratically. Date: 12/1/2024. Title: Site survey of [redacted]. Case ID: Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon (UAP) related. Enclosures: multiple photos taken on FBI-issued phones. Details: In December 2024, Special Agents conducted a site survey of the area around the redacted location to photograph and inspect sites where agents observed UAP activity in November 2024. Agents walked the marked trail clockwise around 10:30 AM (approximately a two-mile loop), departing the trail at west and north points and descending to the water's edge. On the northwest side (around 11:00 AM) they had an unobstructed south-facing line of sight to the subject property; no unusual items were observed at ground or treetop level in the vicinity of the November UAP observations. The north-side inspection likewise revealed no anomalies; an apparent former fire pit showed no signs of recent burns. From the water's edge agents could see multiple homes to the east. Tree cover was moderate, and agents assessed that flying a drone or other craft at night without risk of striking branches would be unrealistic.

documents.summaryText:
文書は米空軍監察官（OSI）ニューヨーク事務所からFBIニューアーク支部長S.I. McKee宛の送付状および複数のOSI報告を含む。主な点は次のとおり。1) 送付状（参照24-.300）は、ライト・パターソン空軍基地のAir Technical Intelligence Center（ATIC）技術分析部からの1952年8月12日付の機密覚書と、The Herald-News（パセイック）記者チャールズ・グレッグによる写真（不特定航空物体を写した約85枚）に関する書簡の写しを同封しており、写真の真偽を判断するために写真家JOHN H. RILBY（28歳、571 Main St., Paterson, N.J.）と既知の目撃者GIORGI J. STOCK（221 Brooks Ave., Passaic, N.J.）の経歴調査および写真家への事情聴取、地域内の追加情報源の探索をFBIに依頼している。OSIは調査報告の写し提供を求めている。2) 目撃報告の要旨（OCR原文に基づく）：- 1957年11月5日：Glen Ridgeの家族が午後中頃に長い円筒形の暗銀色の物体（後部にフィン、翼なし）を低空で南西から北東へ観察。後に夕方に同方向から戻り、モーター音らしきものが聞こえたとしている。- 1957年8月27日：米空軍予備役大尉（報告者名はOCR中“SCHEY”）が午後8:30、Clifton西方で水中爆雷に似た形状の物体を観察。十字形の光が内側から出ており、双眼鏡で菱形の穴状の部分から光が出ているように見えたと報告。- Glen Ridge別報告（時刻記載あり）：午後7:15頃、目撃者の妻が低空を飛行する明るい白色の葉巻形（尾部にデルタ状の翼）を南から北へ飛行するのを観察、音なしと報告。- 1958年2月11日：ユニオン（2630 Vauxhall Road）の女性（OCRで氏名不明）が正午過ぎに弾丸形の銀色物体を観察。翼なし、南方向に非常に高高度で飛行し、蒸気の尾を引き商業機より高かったが音は聞こえなかったと報告。各報告についてOSI関係者への通報記録がある。文書中には索引用紙や標準様式も含まれる。
The documents consist of an OSI (Air Force Office of Special Investigations) New York office cover letter to Mr. S. I. McKee (FBI Newark) and a set of OSI reports/forms. Key points from the OCR text: 1) A transmittal (ref. 24-.300) encloses copies of a restricted memorandum dated 12 August 1952 from the Chief, Technical Analysis Division, Air Technical Intelligence Center (Wright-Patterson AFB) and a letter from Charles Gregg (The Herald-News, Passaic) with approximately 85 photographs alleged to show unidentified aerial objects. ATIC requested the FBI investigate the background of the photographer JOHN H. RILBY (28, 571 Main St., Paterson, N.J.) and known witness GIORGI J. STOCK (221 Brooks Ave., Passaic, N.J.), question the photographer about circumstances of the photos, seek other local sources, and obtain any data pertinent to photo authenticity. OSI requested copies of the FBI investigation reports. 2) Summaries of sighting reports (as transcribed in OCR): - 5 Nov 1957 (Glen Ridge): A family observed a long cylindrical dark-silver object with rear fins (no wings) moving from southwest to northeast at low altitude; it later returned about dusk, emitting what seemed like motor noise, then flew southwest at higher altitude. - 27 Aug 1957: A U.S. Air Force Reserve captain (OCR name “SCHEY”) reported seeing at 8:30 p.m. west of Clifton an object shaped like an underwater demolition bomb with a cross-shaped light from within; with field glasses he reported seeing diamond-shaped holes emitting light. - Glen Ridge (another report): At about 7:15 p.m., a witness’s wife observed a low-flying brilliant white cigar-shaped object with delta-like surfaces toward the tail, silent, flying south to north. - 11 Feb 1958 (Union): A woman at 2630 Vauxhall Road (name unclear in OCR) reported observing at 12:25 p.m. a bullet-shaped silver object, no wings, flying south at very high altitude with a vapor trail, above commercial aircraft, with no audible noise. The files also include index/search slips and standard form entries, and records of OSI notification to agents.

In November 2021, at approximately 0500 local time in the northeastern United States, an eyewitness observed a bright light source near the horizon at an estimated distance of 2,000 feet. The light source initially appeared as a single intense luminous object before resolving into multiple lights exhibiting erratic rotational motion relative to one another. The object slowly moved laterally from left to right during the encounter. The eyewitness captured the video with a hand-held iPhone 12 Pro, resulting in unintended camera movement. The location was well known to the eyewitness and is sparsely populated. The description above is derived from statements provided to the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) by the eyewitness to the event. The FBI assesses the individual who reported this event as highly credible. The subject matter described in files FBI-UAP-D004 through FBI-UAP-D008 and depicted in the video footage FBI-UAP-PR001 through FBI-UAP-PR003 corresponds to reports originating from the same general area in the northeastern United States.

This file contains memoranda, correspondence, reports, and other materials relating to contemporary scientific interest in investigating the nature of luminous phenomena reported by astronauts John Glenn and Walter Schirra during spaceflight. This collection includes transcripts from NASA interviews and debriefings with both astronauts regarding those observations. It also contains details relating to scientific observations of atmospheric phenomena, including brief descriptions of luminous particles, experiences while aboard spacecraft, and circa 1955 theoretical analysis of meteoric particles entering the atmosphere. Pages 34-35, 55-56, 57-63, 64-113, and 122-127 feature content relevant to the PURSUE initiative.

Memos dated June 16 and June 21, 1966 (author: Jocelyn R. Gill). Gemini 9 OSSA experiments performed well overall. S-1 (zodiacal light) was done inside the capsule; Tri‑X film produced the best zodiacal-light and Milky Way images to date. S-11 (airglow horizon photography, NRL) used a wide-angle Maurer lens with a two-filter split field, yielding ~40 usable airglow pictures with good guiding. S-12 (micrometeorite collection) showed highly magnified images (up to 35,000x); a small analyzed area contained 9 impacts; possible cross-contamination between experiment sections is under investigation. Biological experiments: three preflight swabs that were dirty were sterile postflight; T‑4 bacteriophages and Penicillium specimens survived, two other specimens did not. A 30-day report will add results; full micrometeorite analysis will take considerable time. S-5 and S-6 were flown unofficially as operational procedures; ~300 color photos were taken with Hasselblad and Maurer cameras. A strip over Peru revealed a previously unmapped glacial lake; the Peruvian embassy was notified and a military plane dispatched to investigate. The AMU exercise failed—EVA tasks required too much work and two hands for body positioning, making hand-held EVA photography impractical at present.

In November 1962, journalist Walter Cronkite interviewed astronaut Gordon Cooper. In this excerpt from that interview, Cronkite asks Cooper about his views regarding the nature of unidentified flying objects, having previously expressed an interest in the subject. Cooper opines that “a large number of exceptionally well-qualified people have seen objects” without a “logical explanation” and speculates on the existence of other planets with “a livable atmosphere” and that maybe there are “some type of human life” out there. Interview was conducted in November 1962.

USG-UAP-D001、議会、ホワイトハウス、UFO 関連の有権者通信、1998 年
U.S. Government
6/12/26
1998
PDF
This collection of documents, primarily from 1998, contains draft and final correspondence from the White House and the offices of members of Congress responding to constituent inquiries about Unidentified Flying Objects, or “UFOs.” These inquiries cover a diverse range of topics, including alleged UFO sightings by NASA astronauts, questions regarding the authenticity of photos collected during U.S. missions to Mars, alleged improper withholding of information by the U.S. Government, questions regarding the appropriateness of “UFO-related” governmental spending, and calls for congressional hearings regarding the nature and existence of “UFOs.” The official responses consistently state that, circa 1998, the U.S. Government is not aware of evidence supporting the existence of extraterrestrial technology, and that NASA does not actively investigate “UFOs.” The collection includes references to materials of both confirmed and unconfirmed authenticity, as provided by constituents, as well as references to historical, scientific literature addressing specific “UFO” sighting claims.
この文書コレクションは主に 1998 年に作成されたもので、未確認飛行物体 (「UFO」) に関する有権者の質問に応じたホワイトハウスと議員事務所からの文書草案と最終文書が含まれています。これらの調査は、NASAの宇宙飛行士によるUFO目撃疑惑、米国の火星探査中に収集された写真の信憑性に関する疑問、米国政府による不適切な情報保留疑惑、「UFO関連」政府支出の適切性に関する疑問、「UFO」の性質と存在に関する議会公聴会の要請など、多岐にわたる話題を網羅している。公式回答は一貫して、1998年頃、米国政府は地球外テクノロジーの存在を裏付ける証拠を認識しておらず、NASAは「UFO」を積極的に調査していないと述べている。このコレクションには、特定の「UFO」目撃主張に関する歴史的科学文献への参照だけでなく、有権者によって提供された真正性が確認されている資料と未確認の資料への参照も含まれています。

資料は複数のHATS（受信文書アクション）記録と関連文書のOCR抜粋。ID L11998-00407 は上院議員スノー（SNOWE）がメイン州ストッキングトンの市民からのUFOおよび最近の火星写真に関する照会文を転送した記録。ID L/1998-00729 はグラスリー上院議員が宇宙飛行士によるUFO目撃についての照会文を転送した記録。1998年9月4日付のエドワード・ヘファーナン（NASA立法担当副管理者）の回答文は、宇宙飛行士がミッション中に多数の物体を目撃しているが、多くは打上げ機体や宇宙機由来の破片、水滴等と特定され、月ミッションで未確認物質は確認されていないと説明している。空軍は過去に調査を行っていたが中止しており、NASAはUFO調査プログラムを持たず目撃情報を隠蔽していないと明記している。回答にはJames Obergの1976年記事とNASAファクトシートを同封。資料には内部配布メモや、Obergの記事抜粋（宇宙飛行士のUFO目撃事例の列挙、コンドン報告の批判、写真・視覚の制約や宇宙空間のデブリ等による誤認の指摘、情報差控えや写真偽造の可能性への言及、慎重な再検討の呼びかけ）も含まれる。
The documents consist of HATS incoming correspondence records and related OCR excerpts. ID L11998-00407 shows Senator Snowe forwarding a letter from a Stockton, Maine resident interested in UFOs and recently released Mars photos. ID L/1998-00729 shows Senator Grassley forwarding an inquiry requesting information on UFO sightings by astronauts. A NASA reply from Edward Heffernan (Associate Administrator for Legislative Affairs), dated Sept 4, 1998, states that astronauts have observed many objects during missions but most were later identified (launch/spacecraft material, water droplets, etc.), no unidentified materials were seen on lunar missions, the Air Force investigated reports historically but has discontinued that activity, and NASA has no UFO investigation program and has not withheld information. The reply enclosed James Oberg's 1976 article and a NASA fact sheet. Included OCR excerpts of Oberg's article list well-known astronaut-UFO cases (e.g., McDivitt/Gemini‑4, Gemini‑7 photos, Skylab, Apollo rumors), critique the Condon report as superficial and ill-qualified on spaceflight matters, note photographic/visual limitations in space (small/contaminated windows, debris, floating particles), warn of withheld information and photo forgeries, and call for careful review of the evidence.
